newsitem.title: USA: EchoStar looks for Sprint alliance - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: EchoStar looks for Sprint alliance - WSJ.

text.p: EchoStar Communications Corp has begun talks with Sprint Corp as part of its aim to form a strategic alliance with a large corporation, the Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday.

The newspaper said an alliance with Sprint would give EchoStar, which offers direct broadcasting satellite, access to the telephone giant's customer base, while allowing Sprint to attract new customers by offering more services.
It said Sprint officials confirmed the talks.
The newspaper said EchoStar was also talking with Jones Intercable Inc and Lockheed Martin Corp.
